capture: One complete selected-rank8 invocation per process, filtering only _materialize_u_form and the first two _shared_form_gemm kernels; all other kernels are excluded from these totals.
workload: Load the retained frozen rank-8 actions, construct create_lowering('project-rank8', actions), seed torch with 20261018, create two 512x512 CUDA float16 random matrices, allocate selected workspace, execute_selected once in the specified mode, synchronize.
limitations: These are first-execution profiler-replayed kernels from separate processes, without a separate warmup; they are not CUDA-event benchmark operations.
The measured subset omits six generic GEMMs and reconstruction, which are unchanged between the pair.
DRAM writes read as zero or near zero in these short captures and are not a reliable estimate of materialization writes.
Cache state and profiler replay can alter traffic. Two exploratory captures do not establish a DRAM-causality claim.
